summary: Aggregate a dekadal dataset to a published monthly GeoZarr dataset

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published dekadal source collection (e.g. clms_gpp_dekad).

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the monthly GeoZarr dataset to publish (e.g. clms_gpp_monthly).

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable/band name carried through to the published dataset (e.g. gpp).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to aggregate, as [start, end] ISO-8601 dates.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Temporal reducer: mean (default) for per-day rates like GPP/NPP, or sum/min/max for other variables.
